secrets.name: RAZEN_MCP_TOKEN
secrets.description: Bearer token guarding the MCP endpoint (POST /api/mcp). Optional — when unset the endpoint is open. Generate any random string.

secrets.name: TMN_KEY_ID
secrets.description: TrueMoney/TMNOne live API key id. Optional — only needed for live transfers; without it the app runs in simulation mode.

secrets.name: TMN_MSISDN
secrets.description: TrueMoney operator phone number (live mode). Optional.

secrets.name: TMN_PROXY_IP
secrets.description: Proxy IP for TrueMoney API (live mode). Optional.

secrets.name: TMN_PROXY_USERNAME
secrets.description: Proxy username for TrueMoney API (live mode). Optional.

secrets.name: TMN_PROXY_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Proxy password / API token for TrueMoney API (live mode). Optional.

secrets.name: SHIP_SECRET
secrets.description: Shared secret guarding the /api/ship deploy webhook. Optional.

secrets.name: VERCEL_TOKEN
secrets.description: Vercel deploy token for the /api/ship CD pipeline. Optional.
